details: A dirty main checkout breaks the rule that it stays clean and turns gates red in old worktrees. Ignoring node_modules/ everywhere (each ts-deps folder is regenerated by bun) makes the leftover invisible without deleting anything by hand.

details: CONFIRMED. The queue item's why is that the leftover "turns gates red in old worktrees"; the change removes only the first red (dirty status) and the
next step of the same gate fails on the same folder. Ran `claude plugin validate plugins/core/` on a folder with only lib/__pycache__: "No manifest found", rc=1.
In a scratch worktree of HEAD with a simulated leftover, glob("plugins/*/") lists plugins/core first. The fix lies in relay_ci.py, which the change must
touch to keep its promise that the leftover stops breaking gates. Size: 15.
evidence: $ claude plugin validate plugins/core/     (folder holding only lib/__pycache__)
❯ directory: No manifest found in directory. Expected .claude-plugin/marketplace.json or .claude-plugin/plugin.json
failing_case: An old worktree (8 exist: plans-save, queue-edit, relay-plugins, train-19/20/22, paid-aa8cfd1, paid-e905742) takes master: git removes the tracked
plugins/core files and leaves plugins/core/{lib,hooks}/__pycache__ and tests/ts-deps/node_modules. With this change `git status` is clean, so the
gate gets past "commit first", but validate_all builds dirs from glob("plugins/*/") = [plugins/core, plugins/delegate, ...] and runs
`claude plugin validate plugins/core/`, which prints "No manifest found in directory" and exits 1 -> ci step "plugin validate" FAIL, gate red.
Expected: a folder git tracks nothing in is not validated (doctor already names it), the step stays green.
fix_hint: In validate_all keep only plugin folders git tracks something in (`git ls-files -- plugins/<n>` non-empty), or share one helper with
relay_setup.leftover_plugin_folders so both read "a plugin folder" the same way.
pass_cases: 1. temp repo with tracked plugins/relay (valid manifest) and an untracked plugins/core holding only lib/__pycache__/x.pyc: validate_all runs claude validate on "." and plugins/relay/ only, rc 0.
2. same repo with a tracked plugins/broken/ that has no manifest: plugins/broken/ is still validated and rc is 1.
3. a repo whose every plugin folder is tracked and listed: the same dirs as today are validated.
4. claude not on PATH: still "skipped", rc 0.
reason: tests/test_installer_doctor.py ValidateSkipsLeftover: untracked core skipped, tracked broken plugin still validated rc 1; first fails at a4d2ed5.
findings.summary: plugin validate globs plugins/*/ and validates the leftover plugins/core, so the gate of an old worktree is still red after the leftover is made invisible
